import pickle, parse

@parse.with_pattern(r'\d+')
def parse_number(text):
    return int(text)

# Test pickling the decorator factory
d = parse.with_pattern(r'\d+')
pickled = pickle.dumps(d)
unpickled = pickle.loads(pickled)
print('Decorator pickling works:', hasattr(unpickled, 'pattern'))

# Test pickling int_convert
ic = parse.int_convert(16)
pickled_ic = pickle.dumps(ic)
unpickled_ic = pickle.loads(pickled_ic)
print('int_convert pickling works:', callable(unpickled_ic))
